title: Hunters report total silence just before a companion vanished

tellings.quote: And the ones who come back saying right before he disappeared, right before Charlie disappeared, there was no sound.

plain: Hunters who came back from the wilderness after a companion vanished say that just before he disappeared there was no sound at all, total silence. The researcher Jason Jorjani relays this from David Pitus and his Missing 411 series about people who disappear in wild places, giving the example of someone saying, right before Charlie disappeared, there was no sound. The silence is told as a sign that something out of the ordinary was at work.
